# contributing

we welcome contributions to the winuz kernel. 

you might not fully understand the codebase, but let me be the one to fix your code. I am volunteering to do it, as long as your code is okay. Keep it clean.

but maybe, you can give me some advice or suggestions? I highly appreciate suggestions, even without any code.

you are also allowed to use casual language as long as it is informative and i can read it.

hope the best for you!
